title: 第二十二章 噬神虫窟，死亡沙漠
content_zh:
万剑轮回境的石门再次泛起涟漪，一道略显狼狈、但眼神锐利如剑的白衣身影，从中一步踏出。

    正是林墨。

    “林墨！你可算出来了！”守在门外的楚狂歌立刻跳了起来，脸上带着焦急和庆幸，“你再不出来，俺老楚都准备砸门了！”

    “楚兄，到底怎么回事？”林墨看向楚狂歌，又看了一眼闻讯赶来的洛璃，沉声问道。

    楚狂歌立刻将自己从兄弟那里打探到的消息，原原本本地又说了一遍，着重描述了那个轩辕破的诡异之处和他修炼的邪术。

    “吞噬体质……”林墨听完，眉头紧锁。他身负万道剑体，对“体质”的感知远比常人敏锐，也深知这种能够吞噬他人体质、夺取造化的邪术是何等逆天，又何等邪恶。这绝非正道，甚至比“锈”的侵蚀更加令人不齿。

    “消息可靠吗？”洛璃问道。

    “绝对可靠！”楚狂歌拍着胸脯，“俺那兄弟，为人最是仗义，从不撒谎！他亲眼见过轩辕破出手，而且，他还偷偷听到，战族的一位长老，和轩辕帝族的人在密谈，说什么‘噬神虫’已经准备就绪，就等林墨这小子上钩了！”

    “噬神虫？”洛璃脸色一变，“难道是传说中，上古时期，以神灵血肉为食，能吞噬一切生灵本源、甚至连神魂和特殊体质都能剥离吞噬的……禁忌邪物？”

    “对！就是那玩意儿！”楚狂歌心有余悸地点头，“据说，那种邪虫在上古时期，就被各大势力联手剿灭，几乎绝迹了。没想到，竟然被战族和轩辕帝族找到了，还培育了出来！他们恐怕是想在问道台上，用噬神虫，神不知鬼不觉地夺走林墨的万道剑体和始令！”

    “好毒辣的计策！”林墨眼神冰冷。这已经超出了擂台较技的范畴，这是赤裸裸的谋杀和掠夺！而且，对方还试图在天下人面前，光明正大地进行！

    “林师弟，此事已超出了赌约的范畴。”洛璃看向林墨，清冷的眸中带着决然，“我这就去禀报宗主和无名前辈，取消问道台之约！轩辕帝族如此下作，这赌约，不接也罢！”

    “不。”林墨却摇了摇头，目光坚定，“若是现在退缩，不仅会让天下人耻笑，更会让天剑宗和整个东荒，在轩辕帝族面前抬不起头。而且，对方既然布下了这个局，就不会轻易让我们退缩。我们若是不去，他们必然会找其他借口发难，甚至可能直接对天剑宗动手。”

    “那你的意思是？”楚狂歌问道。

    “去！不仅要去，还要在问道台上，当着天下人的面，堂堂正正地击败那个轩辕破，揭穿他们丑恶的嘴脸！”林墨语气斩钉截铁。

    “可是，那噬神虫……”洛璃担忧道。

    “所以，在问道台之战前，我们必须先找到克制噬神虫，或者，至少是防范它的方法！”林墨看向楚狂歌，“楚兄，你那位兄弟，有没有提到，关于克制噬神虫的线索？或者，他们是如何培育、控制噬神虫的？”

    楚狂歌挠了挠头，回忆道：“俺那兄弟只是个小角色，知道的不多。他只听那些人提过一嘴，说什么‘死亡沙漠’的‘噬神虫窟’是源头，要想控制或破解，或许得去那里找找线索……不过他也说了，那地方邪门得很，进去的人，十有八九都出不来了。”

    “死亡沙漠……噬神虫窟……”林墨和洛璃对视一眼，都看到了对方眼中的凝重。

    死亡沙漠，是东荒一处极为著名的生命禁区。那里黄沙万里，终年刮着蚀骨的罡风，沙漠深处，还隐藏着各种诡异的流沙、毒虫、上古残存的杀阵，以及……一些不为人知的恐怖存在。噬神虫的源头如果真的在那里，其危险程度，恐怕不亚于剑墓深处。

    “必须去一趟。”林墨做出了决定，“这是目前唯一的线索。与其被动地等着对方在问道台上用噬神虫暗算，不如主动出击，去源头寻找破解之法！”

    “我跟你一起去。”洛璃毫不犹豫地说道。

    “也算俺一个！”楚狂歌咧嘴一笑，“这事听着就刺激！而且，俺也看战族和轩辕帝族那帮孙子不顺眼很久了！”

    林墨看着洛璃和楚狂歌，心中涌起一股暖流。在这危机四伏的时刻，能有这样的同伴支持，是莫大的幸运。

    “好！那我们即刻出发！”
content_en:
The stone gate of the Ten Thousand Swords Reincarnation Realm rippled again, and a figure in white who looked slightly embarrassed but had eyes as sharp as a sword stepped out of it.

    It was Lin Mo.

    "Lin Mo! You figured it out!" Chu Kuangge, who was guarding the door, immediately jumped up, with anxiety and joy on his face, "If you don't come out, I, Old Chu, will break down the door!"

    "Brother Chu, what's going on?" Lin Mo looked at Chu Kuangge, then at Luo Li who came after hearing the news, and asked in a deep voice.

    Chu Kuangge immediately recounted the information he had learned from his brother exactly as it was, focusing on describing the weirdness of Xuanyuan Po and the evil arts he practiced.

    "Swallowing physique..." Lin Mo frowned after hearing this. He possesses the body of Ten Thousand Swords, and his perception of "physique" is much sharper than ordinary people. He also knows how unnatural and evil this evil magic that can devour other people's bodies and seize creation is. This is definitely not the right way, and is even more despicable than the corrosion of "rust".

    "Is the news reliable?" Luo Li asked.

    "Absolutely reliable!" Chu Kuangge patted his chest, "My brother is the most righteous man and never lies! He has seen Xuanyuan Po take action with his own eyes, and he also secretly heard that an elder of the Zhan Clan was having a secret conversation with people from the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan, saying that the 'God-Eating Insect' was ready, just waiting for this kid Lin Mo to take the bait!"

    "God-eating insect?" Luo Li's face changed. "Is it the legendary, taboo evil thing in ancient times that feeds on the flesh and blood of gods and can devour the origin of all living things, and can even peel off and devour the soul and special physique?"

    "Yes! It's that thing!" Chu Kuangge nodded with lingering fear. "It is said that that kind of evil insect was exterminated by all the major forces in ancient times and was almost extinct. Unexpectedly, it was found by the Zhan Clan and the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan and was cultivated! They probably want to use the God-Eating Insect to steal Lin Mo's Ten Thousand Sword Body and Shiling without anyone noticing on the platform!"

    "What a vicious strategy!" Lin Mo's eyes were cold. This is beyond the scope of competition in the ring, this is naked murder and plunder! Moreover, the other party tried to do it openly and openly in front of everyone in the world!

    "Junior brother Lin, this matter has gone beyond the scope of the bet." Luo Li looked at Lin Mo, with determination in her cold eyes, "I will report to the sect master and senior Wuming to cancel the agreement on the Taoist Platform! The Xuanyuan Imperial Clan has done this, so it’s okay not to accept the bet!"

    "No." Lin Mo shook his head with a firm look, "If we back down now, not only will everyone in the world be laughed at, but it will also make the Tianjian Sect and the entire Donghuang unable to hold their heads high in front of the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan. Moreover, since the other party has set up this situation, they will not let us back down easily. If we don't go, they will definitely find other excuses to attack, and may even attack the Tianjian Sect directly."

    "What do you mean?" Chu Kuangge asked.

    "Go! Not only do you want to go, but you also have to defeat that Xuanyuan Po openly and openly on the platform, in front of everyone in the world, and expose their ugly face!" Lin Mo said firmly.

    "But, that God-Eating Insect..." Luo Li said worriedly.

    "So, before the battle on the Tao Platform, we must first find a way to restrain the God-Eating Insect, or at least prevent it!" Lin Mo looked at Chu Kuangge, "Brother Chu, did your brother mention any clues about restraining the God-Eating Insect? Or, how did they cultivate and control the God-Eating Insect?"

    Chu Kuangge scratched his head and recalled: "My brother is just a small character and doesn't know much. He only heard those people mention it and said that the 'God-eating Insect Cave' in the 'Death Desert' was the source. If you want to control or crack it, you may have to go there to find clues... But he also said that the place is very evil, and most of the people who go in will not be able to get out."

    "Desert of Death...God-Eating Insect Cave..." Lin Mo and Luo Li looked at each other and saw the solemn look in each other's eyes.

    The Desert of Death is a very famous restricted area of ​​life in the Eastern Wasteland. There are thousands of miles of yellow sand there, with bone-eroding winds blowing all year round. In the depths of the desert, there are also hidden various strange quicksands, poisonous insects, remaining killing arrays from ancient times, and... some unknown and terrifying existences. If the source of the God-Eating Insects is really there, the danger would probably be no less than the depths of the Sword Tomb.

    "We have to go there." Lin Mo made a decision, "This is the only clue at present. Instead of passively waiting for the opponent to use the God-eating Insect to plot on the platform, it is better to take the initiative and go to the source to find a way to crack it!"

    "I'll go with you." Luo Li said without hesitation.

    "Count me in!" Chu Kuangge grinned, "This sounds exciting! Moreover, I have also disliked the grandsons of the Zhan Clan and the Xuanyuan Imperial Clan for a long time!"

    Lin Mo looked at Luo Li and Chu Kuangge, and a warm current surged in his heart. In this crisis-ridden time, it is a great blessing to have the support of such companions.

    "Okay! Let's set off immediately!"
title_en: Chapter 22 God-Eating Insect Cave, Desert of Death
